```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reticulate)
cat("=== CONFIGURACIÓN DE PYTHON EN RMD ===\n")
py_config()
cat("\n=== MÓDULOS DISPONIBLES ===\n")
cat("matplotlib:", py_module_available("matplotlib"), "\n")
cat("numpy:", py_module_available("numpy"), "\n")
```

```{python test}
import sys
print("Python executable:", sys.executable)
print("Python version:", sys.version)
print("Python path:", sys.path[:3])

try:
    import matplotlib
    print("matplotlib version:", matplotlib.__version__)
    print("matplotlib location:", matplotlib.__file__)
except ImportError as e:
    print("ERROR importing matplotlib:", e)
```
